question: Which hotel is closest forward of North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH when heading toward Spirit of '76 Museum, Wellington, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.217682 41.168979)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
